Original:
This is a work-in-progress demo of Bits & Bops
and may not be representative of the final product.
Translated:
Это демоверсия Bits & Bops, находящаяся в стадии разработки
и она может не отражать конечный продукт.

Original:
You can join our Discord server at
tempolabgames.com/discord
to report crashes or bugs, give feedback,
or simply hang out with our lovely community.
Translated:
Вы можете присоединиться к нашему серверу Discord по адресу
tempolabgames.com/discord
, чтобы сообщать о сбоях или ошибках, оставлять отзывы
или просто общаться с нашим прекрасным сообществом.

Original:
If you can't use Discord, you can also email
support@tempolabgames.com
and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
Translated:
Если вы не можете использовать Discord, вы также можете написать по электронной почте
support@tempolabgames.com
, и мы свяжемся с вами, как только сможем.

Original: Your copy of the Bits & Bops demo is out of date.
Translated: Ваша копия демо-версии Bits & Bops устарела.

Original:
Please open the game via Steam
while you are connected to the internet
to automatically update the game files.
Translated:
Пожалуйста, откройте игру через Steam
при подключении к Интернету
чтобы автоматически обновить файлы игры.

Original:
You can use the itch.io app available at
itch.io/app
to keep the demo up to date,
or download a new version manually.
Translated:
Вы можете использовать приложение itch.io, доступное по адресу
itch.io/app
, чтобы обновлять демо-версию,
или загрузить новую версию вручную.

Original: The Bits & Bops demo must be launched via Steam.
Translated: Демо Bits & Bops необходимо запустить через Steam.

Original:
It looks like your audio isn't configured correctly,
and the game can't run without it.
Translated:
Похоже, у вас неправильно настроен звук,
и игра без него не запустится.

Original:
We'll switch you to the Fallback engine
to get you unstuck. Press any key to quit,
then relaunch the game.
Translated:
Мы переключим вас на резервный движок,
чтобы вы не застряли. Нажмите любую клавишу, чтобы выйти,
затем перезапустите игру.

Original:
If you're still having trouble,
head over to our Discord at
tempolabgames.com/discord
and let us know in the bug reports channel.
Translated:
Если у вас все еще возникают проблемы,
зайдите в наш Discord по адресу
tempolabgames.com/discord
и сообщите нам об этом в канале отчетов об ошибках.

Original:
If you're not able to fix this error,
head over to our Discord server at
tempolabgames.com/discord
and let us know in the bug reports channel.
Translated:
If you're not able to fix this error,
head over to our Discord server at
tempolabgames.com/discord
and let us know in the bug reports channel.

Original:
It looks like something has gone wrong.
This is a bug that a developer will need to fix.
Translated:
Похоже, что-то пошло не так.
Это ошибка, которую разработчик должен исправить.

Original:
Please report this problem to us at
tempolabgames.com/discord
in the #bug-reports channel.
Translated:
Сообщите нам об этой проблеме по адресу
tempolabgames.com/discord
на канале #bug-reports.

Original:
You can use them to fine-tune the game's performance,
but not every setting will work well on your computer.
Translated:
Вы можете использовать их для более точной настройки производительности игры.,
но не все настройки будут хорошо работать на вашем компьютере.

Misconfiguration can cause audio crackling
and visual stuttering.
Translated:
Неправильная конфигурация может вызвать помехи звука.
и визуальное искажение.

Original: If you get stuck, use the <color=#5AD0FF>Reset to default</color> option!
Translated: Если что-то пошло не так <color=#5AD0FF>сбросьте</color> ваши настройки!

Original: Reset all options on all pages to their default values.
Translated: Сброс всех настроек на всех страницах к их изначальному виду.

Original: Use this if you've got yourself into a mess!
Translated: Используйте это, если вы зашли в тупик!

Original: Press {Action.Confirm} to confirm and restart now.
Translated: Нажмите {Action.Confirm} чтобы подтвердить и перезапустить сейчас.

Original: Control how the game is rendered to the screen.
Translated: Контролируйте, как игра отображается на экране.

Original: Whether to run the game in full screen mode.
The game uses the entire screen with no border.
Translated: Игра открыта в режиме на весь экран.

Original: The game uses a bordered window.
Translated: В игре используется окно с ограничениями.

Original: The resolution of the game window.
The game renders and displays complete frames in sync with your display.
Translated: Игра работает и отображает полные кадры синхронно с вашим дисплеем.

Original: This does not negatively impact input latency.
Translated: Это не влияет негативно на задержку ввода.

Original: This may negatively impact input latency.
Translated: Это может отрицательно повлиять на задержку ввода.

Original: The game generates frames independently of your display, which may result in tearing.
Translated: Игра генерирует кадры независимо от вашего дисплея, что может привести к разрывам.

Original: The maximum number of complete frames to queue.
Lower values mean lower visual latency, but may cause visual stuttering if your computer can't keep up.
Translated: Более низкие значения означают меньшую задержку изображения, но могут вызвать помехи, если ваш компьютер не справляется с этой задачей.

Original: The maximum rate at which the game generates frames.
Translated: Максимальная скорость, с которой игра генерирует кадры.

Original: Higher values use more power and drain battery faster on portable devices.
Translated: Более высокие значения потребляют больше энергии и быстрее разряжают батарею на портативных устройствах.

Original: Control how audio is delivered to your sound card.
Translated: Контролируйте, как звук доставляется на вашу звуковую карту.

Original: The overall volume of all sound output by the game.
Translated: Общая громкость всех звуков, выводимых игрой.

Original: The volume of all menu and in-game music.
Translated: Громкость всего меню и внутриигровой музыки.

Original: The volume of all menu and in-game sound effects.
Translated: Громкость всего меню и внутриигровых звуковых эффектов.

Original: Which audio device to output to.
Routing through a software mixer will increase overall latency.
Translated: Маршрутизация через программный микшер увеличит общую задержку.

Original: Audio is output to the system default device.
Translated: Audio is output to the system default device.

Original: Audio is sent to this device via WASAPI.
Translated: Audio is sent to this device via WASAPI.

Original: Audio is sent to this device via miniaudio.
Translated: Audio is sent to this device via miniaudio.

Original: Audio is sent directly to this device driver.
Translated: Audio is sent directly to this device driver.

Original: Settings are configured via your device driver's control panel.
Translated: Settings are configured via your device driver's control panel.

Original: How audio is delivered to your sound card.
Translated: Как звук доставляется на вашу звуковую карту.

Original: Writes directly to your sound card for lower latency. May not work with some sound cards, and not compatible with other programs including screen recorders.
Translated: Записывание непосредственно на вашу звуковую карту для снижения задержки. Может не работать с некоторыми звуковыми картами и несовместимо с другими программами, включая устройства записи экрана.

Original: Writes directly to your sound card. This may prevent other programs from playing or recording audio.
Translated: Writes directly to your sound card. This may prevent other programs from playing or recording audio.

Original: Generally offers the best compatibility, but has higher audio latency.
Translated: Обеспечивает лучшую совместимость, но имеет более высокую задержку звука.

Original: This value should not be changed in shared mode.
Translated: Это значение не следует изменять в совместном режиме.

Original: Lower values mean lower audio latency, but will cause fuzzing or crackling if your computer can't keep up.
Translated: Более низкие значения означают меньшую задержку звука, но могут вызвать нечеткость или потрескивание, если ваш компьютер не сможет справиться с этой задачей.

Original: Whether to strictly enforce the audio buffer size.
Translated: Whether to strictly enforce the audio buffer size.

Original: The buffer size is strictly enforced.
Translated: The buffer size is strictly enforced.

Original: This may cause stuttering or crackling if your audio output device can't handle the buffer size.
Translated: This may cause stuttering or crackling if your audio output device can't handle the buffer size.

Original: The buffer size is a request that can be overridden by your audio output device.
Translated: The buffer size is a request that can be overridden by your audio output device.

Original: How the audio thread decides when to run.
This performs better on most computers.
Translated: Это работает лучше на большинстве компьютеров.

Original: Only use this if you experience problems with Timer.
Translated: Используйте это только в том случае, если у вас возникли проблемы с таймером.

Original: How the audio thread's priority is set.
Only use this if you experience problems with Standard.
Translated: Используйте это только в том случае, если у вас возникли проблемы со стандартным форматом.

Original: Size of the buffer to use when rendering audio.
Translated: Размер буфера, который будет использоваться при рендеринге звука.

Original: Settings that prioritise latency will cause fuzzing or crackling if your computer can't keep up.
Translated: Настройки, отдающие приоритет задержке, могут вызвать нечеткость или потрескивание, если ваш компьютер не сможет справиться с этой задачей.

Translated: Control how the game reads key and button presses.

Translated: Control how the game reads button presses.

Translated: Reassign buttons to customize input in games and menus.

Translated: Press {Action.Confirm} to bind a button to this action.

Translated: Press a button to bind it to this action.

Translated: {Button} is the last button bound to {Action}.

Translated: Драйвер, который игра использует для взаимодействия с клавиатурой и мышью.

Translated: Используйте этот драйвер только в том случае, если пользовательский драйвер не работает.

Translated: Драйвер, который игра использует для связи с вашими контроллерами.

Original: Uses the Simple DirectMedia Layer library, which is compatible with many different controllers.
Translated: Использует библиотеку Simple DirectMedia Layer, совместимую со многими различными контроллерами.

Original: Specifically built for this game and may give better performance in some circumstances.
Translated: Создан специально для этой игры и в некоторых случаях может обеспечить более высокую производительность.

Original: Whether to lock the mouse cursor to the game area.
Translated: Whether to lock the mouse cursor to the game area.

Original: The mouse cursor is locked to the game area when the mouse is used during gameplay.
Translated: The mouse cursor is locked to the game area when the mouse is used during gameplay.

Translated: The mouse cursor can move freely.

Original: Change various game behaviours to tailor the experience to your individual needs or taste.
Translated: Измените настройки игры, чтобы адаптировать игру к вашим индивидуальным потребностям или вкусу.

Original: The language to use for text in the game.

The engine the game uses to talk to your hardware.
Translated: Движок, который игра использует для взаимодействия с вашим оборудованием.

Translated: Создан специально для этой игры и обеспечивает максимальную производительность.

Translated: Используйте этот движок только в том случае, если пользовательский движок не работает.

Translated: Этот параметр требует перезагрузки. Нажмите {Action.Confirm} чтобы перезагрузить сейчас.

Translated: Use a simplified single-button control scheme during gameplay.

Original: Hit sounds always play perfectly on time.
Translated: Звуки ударов всегда играют идеально вовремя.

Original: This is only recommended if you are using a high latency audio device, for example Bluetooth headphones.
Translated: Это только рекомендовано, если вы играете на устройстве с высокой задержкой, например безпроводных наушниках.

Original: Hit sounds are only played on player input.
Translated: Звуки ударов играют только при вводе игрока.

Original: Amount to offset scheduled sounds to compensate for audio latency.
Translated: Amount to offset scheduled sounds to compensate for audio latency.

Original: Press {Action.Confirm} to begin automatic audio offset calibration.
Translated: Press {Action.Confirm} to begin automatic audio offset calibration.

Original: Audio offset has no effect when scheduled hits are disabled.

Original: Whether to include whole-screen flashing or flickering effects.
Translated: Включить эффекты мигания или мерцания всего экрана.

Original: Some flashing or flickering may still occur. Immediately stop playing and consult a doctor if you experience symptoms of epilepsy.
Translated: Некоторое мигание или мерцание все равно может наблюдаться. Немедленно прекратите играть и обратитесь к врачу, если у вас возникнут симптомы эпилепсии.

Original: Whether to read text using text-to-speech.
Translated: Whether to read text using text-to-speech.

Original: Most game text will be read using text-to-speech.
Translated: Most game text will be read using text-to-speech.

Original: This is not compatible with exclusive mode audio on some systems.
Translated: This is not compatible with exclusive mode audio on some systems.

Original: Whether to describe what is happening during gameplay.
Translated: Whether to describe what is happening during gameplay.

Translated: Scenes and actions will be described by your screen reader during gameplay.

Translated: You may need to configure your screen reader to not interrupt text when buttons are pressed.

Translated: No narration will occur during gameplay.

Translated: Whether to demonstrate the required action in tutorials up-front.

Translated: All required actions in tutorials will be demonstrated before you are given a chance to attempt them.

Translated: The required actions in tutorials will only be demonstrated after failing.

Original: [The screen reader is describing the scene.]
Translated: [The screen reader is describing the scene.]

Original: [The screen reader is describing what happens next.]
Translated: [The screen reader is describing what happens next.]

Original: Scene: A sparkling blue ocean under a pale blue sky. In the bottom left corner of the frame, an orange cat wearing red shorts and holding a camera stands on the deck of a small boat. The boat bobs gently up and down in the water.
Translated: Scene: A sparkling blue ocean under a pale blue sky. In the bottom left corner of the frame, an orange cat wearing red shorts and holding a camera stands on the deck of a small boat. The boat bobs gently up and down in the water.

Original: This seal loves to bop the beach ball.
Translated: Этот тюлень любит отбивать пляжный мяч.

Original: Next: Bubbles appear in the water, then a purple seal emerges with a splash. A multicoloured beach ball descends from the top of the frame. The seal bops the beach ball back into the air with his nose.
Translated: Next: Bubbles appear in the water, then a purple seal emerges with a splash. A multicoloured beach ball descends from the top of the frame. The seal bops the beach ball back into the air with his nose.

Original: Make sure you take the photo right as he hits the ball.
Translated: Обязательно сфотографируйте в тот момент, когда он бьет по мячу.

Original:
Sometimes he likes to juggle the ball.
What a show-off!
Translated:
Иногда ему нравится жонглировать мячом.
Какое шоу!

Original: When you hear the bell, get ready to snap three photos in a row.
Translated: Когда услышите звонок, будьте готовы сделать три фотографии подряд.

Original: Watch the ball for the timing!
Translated: Следите за мячом, чтобы сфотографировать вовремя!

Original: Next: A ship's bell sounds and the cat whips his head left and right. The seal emerges from the water and bounces the ball twice, then bops it back into the air on the third hit.
Translated: Next: A ship's bell sounds and the cat whips his head left and right. The seal emerges from the water and bounces the ball twice, then bops it back into the air on the third hit.

Original: Not quite. Remember: three bops, three photos.
Translated: Не спешите. Помните: три булька, три фотографии.

Original: Keep an eye on the ball for the timing. You've got this!
Translated: Следите за мячом, чтобы попасть вовремя. У тебя получится!

Original:
Whoa there! You've got an itchy trigger finger!
Try slowing down a little.
Translated:
Ого! Это обманный манёвр!
Попробуйте немного замедлиться.

Original: Make sure you wait for the seal to touch the ball before you snap those photos.
Translated: Прежде чем делать эти фотографии, обязательно подождите, пока тюлень коснется мяча.

Original: Great! Now get out there and snap some photos!
Translated: Превосходно! А теперь иди и сделай несколько фотографий!

Original: Wispy clouds drift over palm trees on sandy islands.
Translated: Wispy clouds drift over palm trees on sandy islands.

Original: The camera pans down to bring the orange cat into frame.
Translated: The camera pans down to bring the orange cat into frame.

Original: The boat drifts left carrying the cat out of frame.
Translated: The boat drifts left carrying the cat out of frame.

Original: The boat drifts back showing the cat is gone. A seagull stands atop the camera on a tripod.
Translated: The boat drifts back showing the cat is gone. A seagull stands atop the camera on a tripod.

Original: The cat floats in from the right on an inflatable tube. He is wearing sunglasses and holding a hotdog.
Translated: The cat floats in from the right on an inflatable tube. He is wearing sunglasses and holding a hotdog.

Original: The cat returns to the boat.
Translated: The cat returns to the boat.

Original: The cat and seal switch places.
Translated: The cat and seal switch places.

Original: The cat and seal switch back.
Translated: The cat and seal switch back.

Original: The cat takes the place of the ball.
Translated: The cat takes the place of the ball.

Original: The ball pops on the seal's nose. The seal slowly slinks back into the water.
Translated: The ball pops on the seal's nose. The seal slowly slinks back into the water.

Original: The cat has fallen into the sea and dropped his camera.
Translated: The cat has fallen into the sea and dropped his camera.

Original: The cat shows the seal a photo and they both smile.
Translated: The cat shows the seal a photo and they both smile.

Original: Two photos of the cat and seal having fun together sit on the sand.
Translated: Two photos of the cat and seal having fun together sit on the sand.

Original: You can't always get the perfect shot.
Translated: Вы не всегда можете получить идеальный снимок.

Original: You captured memories that will last a lifetime!
Translated: Вы сохранили воспоминания, которые останутся на всю жизнь!

Original: I hope you're going to pay for all that film.
Translated: Надеюсь ты заплатишь за весь этот фильм.

Original: Scene: A plain background with line art resembling an instruction manual. To the left of the frame, a piece of wood sits idle. To the right of the frame, a hammer has just driven a nail into another piece of wood.
Translated: Scene: A plain background with line art resembling an instruction manual. To the left of the frame, a piece of wood sits idle. To the right of the frame, a hammer has just driven a nail into another piece of wood.

Original: I'll put the nails down, and you hammer them in.
Translated: Я вставляю гвозди, а ты их забиваешь.

Original: Next: A hand appears from the top left to place nails into pieces of wood as they move across the scene from left to right.
Translated: Next: A hand appears from the top left to place nails into pieces of wood as they move across the scene from left to right.

Original: We'll never get anything built this way.
Translated: Мы никогда ничего не построим таким образом.

Original: Listen out for the rhythm when I put them down, then hammer them in as they go past.
Translated: Слушайте ритм, когда я вставляю их, а затем забивайте их, когда они проходят мимо.

Original: Hmm... it looks like a lot of these nails are bent to the left.
Translated: Хм... похоже, многие из этих гвоздей согнуты.

Original:
When that happens, you're hitting them too early.
Try waiting a little longer.
Translated: Когда это происходит, вы наносите им удар слишком рано.<page>Попробуйте подождать еще немного.

Original: Looks like you're still hitting them too early.
Translated: Похоже, ты все еще бьешь их слишком рано.

Original:
Relax, and wait for the nails to come to you.
You can close your eyes if it helps.
Translated: Расслабьтесь и подождите, пока гвозди дойдут до вас. Вы можете закрыть глаза, если это поможет.

Original: These instructions get pretty complicated, so make sure you keep an ear out for the change in rhythm.
Translated: Эти инструкции довольно сложны, поэтому следите за изменением ритма.

Original: An instruction manual sits slightly askew on a wooden table.
Translated: An instruction manual sits slightly askew on a wooden table.

Original: The camera zooms in to make the top two boxes fill the frame.
Translated: The camera zooms in to make the top two boxes fill the frame.

Original: The blocks move smoothly from box 1 to box 2.
Translated: The blocks move smoothly from box 1 to box 2.

Original: The camera cuts to show more of the table.
Translated: The camera cuts to show more of the table.

Original: The camera cuts back and forth between close-up shots of the hand and hammer.
Translated: The camera cuts back and forth between close-up shots of the hand and hammer.

Original: The camera zooms out to show a white cat sitting on the instruction manual.
Translated: The camera zooms out to show a white cat sitting on the instruction manual.

Original: The camera cuts between multiple rotated angles.
Translated: The camera cuts between multiple rotated angles.

Original: The camera shows the cat on the instruction manual again.
Translated: The camera shows the cat on the instruction manual again.

Original: The cat sits on top of the manual obscuring view of the hammer.
Translated: The cat sits on top of the manual obscuring view of the hammer.

Original: The camera settles. Blocks disappear from box 1 and reappear later in box 2.
Translated: The camera settles. Blocks disappear from box 1 and reappear later in box 2.

Original: The camera returns to the starting view.
Translated: The camera returns to the starting view.

Original: The cat has climbed under a pile of loose wooden boards.
Translated: The cat has climbed under a pile of loose wooden boards.

Original: The cat watches a TV which sits atop a new cabinet.
Translated: The cat watches a TV which sits atop a new cabinet.

Original: The cat sits on top of a newly built cabinet.
Translated: The cat sits on top of a newly built cabinet.

Original: I hope this is covered under warranty.
This looks like it will hold together.
It looks just like the picture!
Translated: Это выглядит так же, как на картинке!
Нам не нужен был отбойный молоток.

Original: Scene: The interior of a house with pale green floral wallpaper. To the left of the frame, an open window shows greenery outside, and a blue radio sits on the windowsill. To the right of the frame, a yellow canary sits on a perch.
Translated: Scene: The interior of a house with pale green floral wallpaper. To the left of the frame, an open window shows greenery outside, and a blue radio sits on the windowsill. To the right of the frame, a yellow canary sits on a perch.

Original: Listen for the question, then tap {Action.Primary} to respond.
Translated: Прослушайте вопрос, затем нажмите {Action.Primary} чтобы ответить.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio. Subtitles showing "Tweet tweet" in blue and "tweet" in yellow appear at the bottom of the screen. A bouncing ball in the shape of Bop's face bounces evenly across the three words.
Translated: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio. Subtitles showing "Tweet tweet" in blue and "tweet" in yellow appear at the bottom of the screen. A bouncing ball in the shape of Bop's face bounces evenly across the three words.

Original: Not quite. Watch for the timing, and don't jump in before your turn.
Translated: Не совсем. Следите за временем и не отвечайте раньше своей очереди.

Original: Excuse me, you're talking over the question!
Translated: Извините, вы говорите по поводу вопроса!

Original: When you hear tweet tweet, you answer tweet.
Translated: Когда ты слышишь чик чик, ты отвечаешь чирик.

Original:
Conversation is best when allowed to flow naturally.
Try the same question without the bouncing ball.
Translated: Разговор лучше всего протекает когда выглядит естественным.<page>Попробуйте задать тот же вопрос без подсказки.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio as before, but this time no lyrics or bouncing ball appear. If you're hearing this, that may not make a difference to you.
Translated: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio as before, but this time no lyrics or bouncing ball appear. If you're hearing this, that may not make a difference to you.

Original: Not quite. Concentrate on the timing, same as before. You can close your eyes if it helps.
Translated: Не совсем. Сконцентрируйтесь на времени, как и раньше. Можешь закрыть глаза, если это поможет.

Original: When you hear tweet tweet tweet, you wait a little before answering.
Translated: Когда ты слышишь чик чик чик, немного подожди перед тем, как отвечать.

Original: Canary thinks carefully about complicated questions.
Tap {Action.Primary} to respond after a short delay.
Translated: Нажмите {Action.Primary} чтобы ответить после небольшой задержки.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio. Subtitles showing "Tweet tweet tweet" and a dash in blue and "tweet" in yellow appear at the bottom of the screen. A bouncing ball in the shape of Bop's face bounces quickly across the three blue words, then evenly to the dash and the final yellow word.
Translated: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio. Subtitles showing "Tweet tweet tweet" and a dash in blue and "tweet" in yellow appear at the bottom of the screen. A bouncing ball in the shape of Bop's face bounces quickly across the three blue words, then evenly to the dash and the final yellow word.

Original: Excellent! Now let's try this one without the bouncing ball.
Translated: Отлично! Теперь давайте попробуем это без подсказки.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio as before, but this time no lyrics or bouncing ball appear. If that didn't make a difference to you last time, it won't make a difference to you this time either.
Translated: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio as before, but this time no lyrics or bouncing ball appear. If that didn't make a difference to you last time, it won't make a difference to you this time either.

Original: Now if only there were someone to talk to...
Translated: Вот если бы было с кем поговорить...

Original: The window blind is down and the room is dim.
Translated: The window blind is down and the room is dim.

Original: The blind lifts to reveal a blue wren on the windowsill where the radio previously sat.
Translated: The blind lifts to reveal a blue wren on the windowsill where the radio previously sat.

Original: The birds talk about their home lives. The wren raises a family and the canary eats chips.
Translated: The birds talk about their home lives. The wren raises a family and the canary eats chips.

Original: The birds talk about their exercise routines. The wren flies outside and the canary gives up on lifting weights.
Translated: The birds talk about their exercise routines. The wren flies outside and the canary gives up on lifting weights.

Original: The birds talk about their diets. The wren forages for food and the canary gets ice cream from the refridgerator.
Translated: The birds talk about their diets. The wren forages for food and the canary gets ice cream from the refridgerator.

Original: The birds talk about music. The wren sings with her friends and the canary sings with the radio.
Translated: The birds talk about music. The wren sings with her friends and the canary sings with the radio.

Original: The birds talk about each other. They have enjoyed their conversation.
Translated: The birds talk about each other. They have enjoyed their conversation.

Original: Canary sits on the couch alone with a bag of chips.
Translated: Canary sits on the couch alone with a bag of chips.

Original: The birds share a bag of potato chips.
Translated: The birds share a bag of potato chips.

Original: The birds joyfully fly high in the sky together.
Translated: The birds joyfully fly high in the sky together.

Original: Seems something was lost in translation.
That's enough chit-chat for one day.
You've got a real way with words!
Translated: У тебя крутой подход к тому, что ты говоришь!

Original: You made a friend for life!
Translated: Ты нашёл друга на всю жизнь!

Original: Try letting someone else speak occasionally.

An auditorium with an array of large speakers and unlit lights affixed to the scaffolding. A yellow robot stands in the centre of the stage, with two female backup dancers standing behind him to his left and right. The dancers are wearing sneakers and trackpants with sideways yellow caps.
Translated: An auditorium with an array of large speakers and unlit lights affixed to the scaffolding. A yellow robot stands in the centre of the stage, with two female backup dancers standing behind him to his left and right. The dancers are wearing sneakers and trackpants with sideways yellow caps.

Original: Listen up, crew! We've got moves to learn!
Translated: Listen up, crew! We've got moves to learn!

Original: When we clap three times, tap {Action.Primary} four times to dance with us.
Translated: When we clap three times, tap {Action.Primary} four times to dance with us.

Original: Next: The backup dancers clap above their heads, then throw out their hands alternating to the left and right.
Translated: Next: The backup dancers clap above their heads, then throw out their hands alternating to the left and right.

Original: Not quite — we clap three times, you dance four times.
Translated: Not quite — we clap three times, you dance four times.

Original: Press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin, and release to freeze!
Translated: Press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin, and release to freeze!

Original: Watch for the one-two cue, then show us your moves!
Translated: Watch for the one-two cue, then show us your moves!

Original: Listen for the one-two record scratch, then show us your moves!
Translated: Listen for the one-two record scratch, then show us your moves!

Original: Next: The backup dancers throw up their elbows, then spin rapidly on the ground, before finally freezing with one hand planted on the ground and legs splayed in the air.
Translated: Next: The backup dancers throw up their elbows, then spin rapidly on the ground, before finally freezing with one hand planted on the ground and legs splayed in the air.

Original: Not quite — watch for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.
Translated: Not quite — watch for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.

Original: Not quite — listen for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.
Translated: Not quite — listen for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.

Original: Red curtains part to reveal the stage. The overhead lights flash in an alternating pattern.
Translated: Red curtains part to reveal the stage. The overhead lights flash in an alternating pattern.

Original: The stage lights shine neon pink, and lights on the speakers flash with the melody.
Translated: The stage lights shine neon pink, and lights on the speakers flash with the melody.

Original: The lights are cut and the stage lights flash neon green.
Translated: The lights are cut and the stage lights flash neon green.

Original: The stage lights flash neon orange.
Translated: The stage lights flash neon orange.

Original: The dancers strike a relaxed pose on the ground.
Translated: The dancers strike a relaxed pose on the ground.

Original: The dancers fiddle with wires in the robot's head.
Translated: The dancers fiddle with wires in the robot's head.

Original: The trio kneel triumphantly on the stage.
Translated: The trio kneel triumphantly on the stage.

Original: The robot is carried by a cheering audience.
Translated: The robot is carried by a cheering audience.

Original: Seems there are still a few bugs to work out.
Translated: Seems there are still a few bugs to work out.

Original: Looks like you're set to double time.
Translated: Looks like you're set to double time.

Original:
Thank you for playing the
Bits & Bops Kickstarter demo!
Translated:
Спасибо, что играл в
Bits & Bops Kickstarter демо!

Original:
Beat all three stages in a row
to go for a high score!
Translated:
Пройдите все три этапа подряд
Чтобы получить высший счёт!

Notes: This judgement is also called "Perfect" and is usually differentiated only by color
() causes Windows TTS to say "resume" instead of "résumé"

Original: Accessibility has been enabled. To disable, press Shift+{Key}+A
Translated: Accessibility has been enabled. To disable, press Shift+{Key}+A

Original: Accessibility has been disabled. To re-enable, press Shift+{Key}+A
Translated: Accessibility has been disabled. To re-enable, press Shift+{Key}+A

Original: Here, let me start the metronome...
All you have to do is tap {Action.Primary} in time with the metronome. It's that simple!
Translated: Всё что вам надо делать это нажимать {Action.Primary} под ритм метронома. Всё так просто!

Original: Just keep going until we get a good reading.
Translated: Просто продолжайте пока мы не получим правильные показания.

Original: Looks like your total delay is {Delay}ms.
This number should only be negative if your true delay is small and you're tapping a little early.
Translated: Это число должно быть негативным толькр если ваша истинная задержка низкая и вы нажимаете немного рано.

Original:
If that's the case, you probably don't need to calibrate.
I'll set your offset to 0ms.
Translated:
Если это правда, вам скорее всего не надо калибровка.
Я установлю вашу задержку на 0мс.

Original: I'll apply this offset whenever you have scheduled hits enabled in the settings.
Translated: Я применю эту задержку когда у вас включены планированые удары в настройках.

Original: Since your delay is relatively small, you may enjoy the game more if you disable scheduled hits.
Translated: Поскольку у вас отнолсительно низкая задержка, вам может больше понравится игра если вы выключите планированые удары.

Original: Since your delay is relatively large, you may enjoy the game more if you enable scheduled hits.
Translated: Поскольку у вас отнолсительно высокая задержка, вам может больше понравится игра если вы включите планированые удары.

Original: By the way, it's a good idea to recalibrate any time you change your input or audio device.
Translated: Кстати, перекалиброватся каждый раз когда меняете устройство ввода или аудио - хорошая идея.

Original: Feel free to come back and recalibrate any time!
Translated: Не стесняйтесь вернутся и перекалибровать в любое время!
